NONE: › mathematics relating to or around a real or imaginary straight line going through the centre of an object that is spinning, or a line that divides a symmetrical shape into two equal halves
軸的；軸線的
› anatomy relating to an imaginary line through the centre of the body
（身體）中心線的
› anatomy relating to the axis (= the second of the small bones in the neck that form the spine and support the skull)
樞椎的，第二頸椎的
› on a plant, the angle between the top of a leaf or stem and the stem or branch that it grows from
葉腋（植物葉或莖的頂部與其所處的葉梗或枝條間所形成的角）
› a technical word for the armpit (= the hollow place under your arm where your arm joins your body)
腋，腋窩
› formal a statement or principle that is generally accepted to be true, but need not be so
（被普遍接受的）公理，原則
› specialized science a formal statement or principle in mathematics, science, etc., from which other statements can be obtained
（數學、自然科學等的）公理

example: It is a widely held axiom that governments should not negotiate with terrorists.
政府不應與恐怖分子談判，這是一個普遍認可的原則。
Euclid's axioms form the foundation of his system of geometry.
歐幾裡得公理構成了其幾何體系的基礎。

NONE: › obviously true and therefore not needing to be proved
成為公理的；不需證明的，不言自明的

example: It is an axiomatic fact that governments rise and fall on the state of the economy.
經濟狀況決定政府的興衰成敗，這是不言自明的事實。
It seems axiomatic that everyone would benefit from a better scientific education.
更好的科學教育會使每個人受益，這似乎是不言自明的。

C: › a real or imaginary straight line going through the centre of a object that is spinning, or a line that divides a symmetrical shape into two equal halves
› a fixed line on a graph used to show the position of a point
參考軸線，基準線，坐標線
› specialized anatomy, medical the second of the small bones in the neck that form the spine and support the skull
› an agreement between governments or politicians to work together to achieve a particular aim
軸心（指政府或從政者之間的聯盟）

NONE: › the countries, including Germany, Italy, and Japan, that fought against the Allies in the Second World War
（第二次世界大戰中的）軸心國

example: The earth revolves around the axis that joins the North and South Poles.
地球圍繞貫穿南北兩極的地軸自轉。
The diameter of a circle is also an axis.
一個圓的直徑也是一條軸線。
Plot distance on the vertical y-axis against time on the horizontal x-axis.
用縱坐標Y軸表示距離，用橫坐標X軸表示時間。

NONE: › Germany, Italy, and Japan during World War II
（第二次世界大戰中的）軸心國
